title: Composition law for Bernoulli restriction weights
statement:
Fix parameters $p, q \in \bbr$ and a restriction $\sigma$ on $n$ variables. Summing the product of the Bernoulli weight of $\rho_1$ at parameter $p$ and the Bernoulli weight of $\rho_2$ at parameter $q$ over all pairs of restrictions $(\rho_1, \rho_2)$ on $n$ variables whose composition equals $\sigma$ yields the Bernoulli weight of $\sigma$ at parameter $pq$:
\[
  \sum_{\rho_1}\sum_{\rho_2}
    w_p(\rho_1)\, w_q(\rho_2)\,
    [\,\rho_1 \circ \rho_2 = \sigma\,]
  = w_{pq}(\sigma),
\]
where $w_r(\rho)$ denotes the Bernoulli weight of $\rho$ at parameter $r$, $\rho_1 \circ \rho_2$ is the restriction that fixes each coordinate to the value given by $\rho_1$ where defined and to that of $\rho_2$ otherwise, and $[\,\cdot\,]$ is the indicator taking the value $1$ when its condition holds and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: parameters p, q are real numbers
sigma is a restriction on n variables
sum ranges over all pairs of restrictions on n variables
indicator selects pairs whose composition equals sigma
replaced:
Summing the product $\mathrm{bernoulliRestrWeight}\,p\,\rho_1 \cdot
\mathrm{bernoulliRestrWeight}\,q\,\rho_2$ over all pairs $(\rho_1, \rho_2)$ that
compose to $\sigma$ equals the Bernoulli weight of $\sigma$ at parameter $pq$:
\[
  \sum_{\rho_1}\sum_{\rho_2} \mathrm{bernoulliRestrWeight}\,p\,\rho_1 \cdot
    \mathrm{bernoulliRestrWeight}\,q\,\rho_2 \cdot
    [\,\mathrm{composeRestr}\,\rho_1\,\rho_2 = \sigma\,]
  = \mathrm{bernoulliRestrWeight}\,(pq)\,\sigma.
\]
